_comment: De-dup ledger for the Sentry New-Error Spike Alert schedule (skills/sentry-spike-alert.md). Seeded 2026-08-07 from the investigation that motivated the schedule.

SUPERSET-PYTHON-12EZ.note: Chronic since 2026-04-27 — QueryObjectValidationError 'list object has no element 0', a customer virtual-dataset Jinja template rendering error (ChartDataRestApi.data). ~115k events/7d, 0 users, handled. Dominant volume driver, not a new spike. Only re-alert if >=3x this peak.

SUPERSET-PYTHON-158W.note: fsspec ImportError in SqlLabRestApi.execute_sql_query, workspace 73cc29dd (ai-tutor Athena/S3 reads). New 2026-08-03, escalating, 5 users. Code/dependency-shaped.

SUPERSET-PYTHON-15GE.note: OperationalError: MySQLdb can't connect (errno 2002/115), culprit ChartDataRestApi.data. Customer-owned DB unreachable from Preset — customer-DB-config infra-noise per skills/sentry-error-burndown.md skip-list. 0 users throughout, quiet since 2026-08-24T13:20Z (no growth since last check). Was held in `held_pending_ooo` since crossing the New-lens threshold on 2026-08-22 (197 events, firstSeen<=72h then); released and DMed today per the ledger's own re-evaluate note now that Elizabeth is back from OOO (project_elizabeth_ooo_2026_08_18, back ~2026-08-25). Never crossed the 500/24h escalating bar on its own. Re-alert only if it starts affecting users (userCount>0) or crosses 500 events/24h.

SUPERSET-PYTHON-YD4.note: MultiTenantException: Binding workspace db is different from SQLA session db, in preset/multi_tenant/base.py::check_workspace_db_session_binding (superset-shell tenant-isolation guard), tripped during JWT auth (load_user_from_request->upsert_role->find_role). Code-shaped, security-relevant. Chronic since 2025-12-10, 568 users all-time, still firing. Part of an 8+ issue family sharing the same exception/culprit fingerprint: YD3 (372/24h, 569 users), YD5 (294/24h, 569 users), D36 (distinct workspace pairing, chronic since 2023, 7 users), plus YD7/Q3S/YE4/YD6/RSN/TB9 (lower volume). Not individually New (firstSeen far >72h) or Sentry-tagged is:escalating, but flagged as a top contributor to today's 1.69x org-wide 24h volume jump (22685 vs 13444) since the standing websocket/502/SSL infra cluster was flat day-over-day. Already investigated twice by the daily Sentry burndown pipeline (memory/2026-08-23.md, memory/2026-08-24.md) — root cause traced to a plausible session/context-binding race in the auth path, deliberately not patched given cross-tenant-leakage blast radius, flagged internally both times but never DMed until today. Re-alert if any sibling issue individually crosses 500/24h, or if userCount starts climbing sharply (would suggest active leakage, not just steady chronic firing).

2026-08-14-search-index-stale.note: CORRECTED 2026-08-14 PM (in-thread with Elizabeth, same day): not a stuck search index. Org preset-inc has been over its Sentry error-event quota since 2026-08-05T20:54 UTC — stats_v2 split by outcome shows accepted/category=error = 0 every day 08-06 through 08-14 (was 76,102 on 08-04), while client_discard/rate_limited climbed instead (reasons: error_usage_exceeded, ratelimit_backoff). lastSeen=2026-08-05 on every issue is therefore correct, not stale — nothing new has actually landed. The 08-12->08-13 '2.42x org-wide jump' (46,264->112,051) re-attributed to project superset-python alone, and it's a spike in rejected (ratelimit_backoff) volume, not accepted errors — not a real dashboard doubling. /api/0/subscriptions/preset-inc/ 404s on this token — no quota/reset visibility without org-owner billing access. DMed + corrected same thread (D0BBR2PPFQ9, ts=1786716266.840669); Elizabeth engaged live but thread has no billing-side resolution yet.
2026-08-14-search-index-stale.status: UPDATE 2026-08-25: org-wide volume-delta today is 22685 vs prior 13444 (1.69x, still nominally over 1.5x) — this run DMed Elizabeth (see `alerted.SUPERSET-PYTHON-YD4`/`SUPERSET-PYTHON-15GE` above) since the driver this time is genuinely new information for this alert channel (the MultiTenantException family + a released OOO-hold item), not a re-run of this same recovery-ramp story. The chronic websocket/502/SSL cluster (VVE/YE9/A9F/A2F/13JV/VVF/VVG/F2) remains flat (~13.6k both today and yesterday's total), so this outage-recovery narrative is fully settled/inactive as a contributor. RECOVERED 2026-08-19, still ramping 2026-08-20 — org-wide volume-delta today: current 24h=21681 vs prior 24h=7705 (2.81x, nominally over the 1.5x org-wide-jump threshold). Checked top contributors before deciding whether this is news: SUPERSET-PYTHON-12EZ (acknowledged_baseline) is 13171/24h, ~61% of the total — cross-checked against its 7d-scoped count (18205/7d, i.e. ~2600/day average over the week including the near-zero days) and its historical peak_events_7d baseline (115244, i.e. ~16463/day pre-outage) — today's 24h rate is close to but still under that historical daily average, so this reads as 'still climbing back to normal,' not a re-escalation (not >=3x peak, no re-alert trigger). The rest of the org-wide total is spread across other pre-existing chronic issues that also resumed after the quota outage (SUPERSET-PYTHON-YE9 firstSeen 2025-12-11, MANAGER-PYTHON-40E firstSeen 2026-07-21, websocket/502/SSL/timeout infra-noise cluster A9F/VVE/XVB/YYS/YFN/VVF/VVG/A2F/F2/ZVK/13JV) — none newly created, none tagged is:escalating by Sentry, none individually crossing the New (>=100 events, firstSeen<=72h) or Escalating (>=500 events/24h) thresholds (max in either lens was 27 events, on unrelated small new issues from 08-19/08-20). Conclusion: this is the same 08-19 recovery event continuing to ramp toward steady-state, not new information — did NOT re-DM. Elizabeth still OOO per project_elizabeth_ooo_2026_08_18 (routine pings on hold, back ~08-25); the SUPERSET-PYTHON-12EZ fix is still the open PR apache/superset#43081 (sc-117145). Re-alert if: accepted volume drops back toward 0 (recovery reverses), any issue starts showing is:escalating with >=500 events/24h now that real signal is flowing, or 12EZ's 24h rate pushes past its ~16463/day historical average by a wide margin (would suggest genuine re-escalation, not just recovery ramp). UPDATE 2026-08-24: org-wide volume-delta today is 13482 vs prior 4645 (2.90x, still nominally over 1.5x), but the picture has flipped from 'ramping back up' to 'settled into steady-state infra-noise' — SUPERSET-PYTHON-12EZ has gone fully quiet (lastSeen 2026-08-20T22:29Z, zero events in the trailing 24h per both the issue lookup and a 24h-scoped org search) and is no longer a contributor at all. The current 24h top-15 by freq is entirely the same known chronic cluster (VVE, A9F, VVF, VVG, BS3, 96T, A2F, F2, 13JV, YE9, MANAGER-PYTHON-1G5) plus report-execution noise (15FR, ZR1) — same categories as 08-20, still lastSeen 08-24 (i.e. genuinely active, not stale), none individually crossing New/Escalating thresholds. Conclusion unchanged: not new information, did NOT re-DM. Re-alert conditions unchanged (see above), now effectively simplified since 12EZ is quiet: watch for any single chronic issue in the cluster crossing 500 events/24h on its own, or a genuinely new (non-cluster) issue driving the delta.
